softSkills.title: Soft Skills
items: When something grabs me, I go deep
Care over speed — doing things right, not just done

about.text: Frontend engineer with 4+ years of production experience building complex, customer-facing web applications. I care about code that lasts – readable, maintainable, and built with the people using it in mind. Currently expanding into full-stack development through a professional bootcamp (April–August 2026). I work best when I have ownership, enjoy figuring out ambiguous problems, and genuinely enjoy digging into complex problems until they click.

job1.title: Frontend Developer
job1.description: Complex web application for an international agricultural machinery manufacturer. Vue.js, TypeScript, AG Grid.
bullets: Developed and shipped multiple data-heavy features; owned entire lifecycle from analysis through deployment
Conducted independent data analysis project: built Python visualizations analyzing prototype scrapping costs
Worked closely with stakeholders during customer demos; rapid feedback loops refined problem-solving approach
Contributed to code quality: code reviews, test coverage, refactoring; focus on maintainability and scalability

job2.title: Self-Employed | E-Commerce
job2.description: E-commerce projects for various clients. Shopware 5, design implementation, project coordination.
bullets: Owned project lifecycle: shop setup, design implementation, technical integration, client handoff
Designed and built storefronts on Shopware; managed scope and stakeholder communication
Built practical knowledge in systems thinking: infrastructure fundamentals, vendor management, customer support
